description: List a project's screen names and active version numbers without generated HTML. Pass each item's screenId to design. Pass its id as componentId to get_component or in componentIds to screenshot. Use get_component only when you need a screen's code.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before this page.

projectId.description: Project id from an item's id in list_projects, or data.id in create_project.

name: list_components

activeVersion.description: Version number the screen currently shows. Null before the screen has a version.

id.description: Use as componentId to fetch HTML or in componentIds to render screenshots.

screenId.description: Pass as screenId to design to edit this screen. Null when the component is not placed on the canvas.

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

title: List screens
